items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I used to like, well I still do like some of the works. Fats Waller, Oscar Peterson and some of those guys.

ctx.x: Have you played with any other bands? Mm-hmm. Who are some of your favorites? Let's see, we ought to get that down.

On what instruments? Well, on piano first. George Shearing is my favorite. Quite odd here. This type of music. But I really do like George Shearing rather. And I used to like, well I still do like some of the works. Fats Waller, Oscar Peterson and some of those guys.
Your style certainly doesn't sound like those fellas.
